Four non-test files import `convertToSmallestCurrencyUnit` from `@calcom/lib/currencyConversions` and call it. Two test files also relate to it, though neither imports or calls it:

- `packages/features/bookings/lib/handlePayment.ts` imports it and calls it at line 161.
- `packages/app-store/stripepayment/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` imports it and calls it at line 109.
- `packages/app-store/paypal/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` imports it and calls it at line 80.
- `packages/app-store/hitpay/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` imports it and calls it at line 88.
- `packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/PaymentService.ts` imports it from `@calcom/lib/currencyConversions` and calls it at line 160.
- `packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/PaymentService.test.ts` and `packages/app-store/paypal/lib/Paypal.test.ts` only mention it in comments. They exercise the code indirectly through `PaymentService` and `Paypal`.

Two other files define their own local `convertToSmallestCurrencyUnit`, so they are not users of the `packages/lib` one:

- `packages/app-store/btcpayserver/lib/currencyOptions.ts` defines it. `packages/app-store/btcpayserver/components/EventTypeAppSettingsInterface.tsx` uses that local copy through `../lib/currencyOptions`.
- `packages/app-store/hitpay/lib/currencyConversions.ts` defines its own copy at line 20. Nothing in `packages/` or `apps/` imports that copy, so it appears unused.
